sanskrit_verse:
प्रवृत्तचक्रतां चैव वाणिज्यप्रभृतीन् अपि ।
अरोगित्वं यशो वीतशोकतां परमां गतिम् ॥२६६॥
transliteration: pravṛttacakratāṃ caiva vāṇijyaprabhṛtīn api | arogitvaṃ yaśo vītaśokatāṃ paramāṃ gatim ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Engagement in cyclical duties, including trade and commerce, leads to freedom from disease, glory, transcendence of sorrow, and ultimate liberation.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through dharmic engagement in societal roles
Causation aligns action with health, reputation, and spiritual progress
Capacity-based responsibility demands participation in sustaining social order
Restoration logic ensures material and spiritual elevation through duty
Consciousness alignment arises from harmonious fulfillment of role-bound actions
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor engages in lawful economic activity THEN physical and mental well-being shall increase
IF individual performs prescribed occupational duty THEN social honor and inner peace shall accrue
IF person acts without deviation from svadharma THEN sorrow diminishes and higher states emerge
IF economic conduct aligns with dharma THEN automatic restoration of personal and collective integrity occurs
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating commercial disputes or regulatory compliance, the court must recognize that lawful engagement in economic cycles inherently restores individual and societal balance. The threshold of responsibility lies not in punitive oversight but in ensuring alignment with dharmic structures that naturally elevate consciousness and eliminate suffering.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Through pramāṇa-based observation, it is established that rightful action in cyclical societal functions manifests sequentially as health, fame, emotional stability, and liberation. Responsibility is measured by alignment with these natural consequences rather than imposition of external judgment. No punitive framework is required where dharma itself enforces harmony.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Ensure all economic actors fulfill their svadharma within lawful frameworks
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Encourage individuals to reclaim agency in their role-based duties
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Reinforce access to dharmic livelihoods that promote holistic well-being
Integrity Reintegration Pathway: Align economic behavior with consciousness-centered outcomes
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: Dharma governs action-result alignment; justice is the unfolding of inherent consequence; reality is non-punitive when aligned with svadharma; consciousness alone is the final adjudicator.
